+def test_rst_with_header_rows():
+    """Test RST write with header_rows parameter"""
+    tbl = [
+        "==== ========= ==== ====",
+        "Col1      Col2 Col3 Col4",
+        "==== ========= ==== ====",
+        " 1.2   "hello"    1    a",
+        " 2.4 's worlds    2    2",
+        "==== ========= ==== ====",
+    ]
+    header_rows = ["name"]
+    dat = ascii.read(tbl, format="rst", header_rows=header_rows)
+    out = StringIO()
+    ascii.write(dat, out, format="rst", header_rows=header_rows)
+    assert_equal_splitlines(out.getvalue(), "\n".join(tbl))
